title: Destination Chess
tagline: Eight places to sit down for a game.
description: Chess on a 3D walnut board at eight getaway spots: a cruise ship, an island, a busy city street, a quiet park, the desert, the arctic tundra, a campsite and a sports bar. Every level is open from level select, each with three scenes. Play the CPU on Easy, Normal or Hard, or pass and play with a friend.
